# endfield-skydoc (generated site)

This repository hosts the built static site served at
<https://kokobird28144.github.io/endfield-skydoc/>.

**Do not edit files here by hand.** Every publish replaces the whole tree from
the site build; local changes are overwritten.

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html`, `<slug>.html` | English pages |
| `zh/` | Chinese pages |
| `assets/` | Hashed JS/CSS bundles, regenerated on each build |
| `logistics/src/assets/images/` | Article images (originals plus WebP derivatives) |
| `images/` | Site logo and licence texts |
| `src/` | Redirect stubs for pre-2026-10 addresses |
| `resource-availability.html` | Retired page; redirects to the landing page |
| `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, `404.html` | Generated site metadata |

Source content, sync state and the build tooling live outside this repository.
